text: Figure 11.32: E2E MethodProtection [TPS_MANI_03130]{DRAFT} Standardized values of the attribute E2EProfileConfiguration.profileName ⌈The E2EProfileConfiguration. profileName that is referenced by an End2EndEventProtectionProps or by an End2EndMethodProtectionProps can have the following values that are standardized by AUTOSAR: PROFILE_04, PROFILE_05, PROFILE_06, PROFILE_- 07, PROFILE_08, PROFILE_11, PROFILE_22, PROFILE_04m, PROFILE_07m, PROFILE_44, PROFILE_08m, and PROFILE_44m.⌋(RS_MANI_00028) [TPS_MANI_03131]{DRAFT} Non-Standardized values of attribute E2EProfileConfiguration.profileName⌈The values for the profileName of E2EProfileConfiguration mentioned in [TPS_MANI_03130] are standardized and reserved for being used in the way the AUTOSAR standard foresees. PROFILE_01 and PROFILE_02 are also reserved by AUTOSAR but excluded for us- age on the AUTOSAR adaptive Platform . In addition, it is positively possible to use other than the standardized values for the profileName.⌋(RS_MANI_00028)
